items.rule_bn: চিরন্তন সত্য Present Indefinite-এ; singular তাই rises।

items.q: I ___ my breakfast before I went to school. (finish)
items.rule_bn: অতীতে আগের কাজ Past Perfect: had + V3 (had finished)।
'for five years' চলমান — Present Perfect / Perfect Continuous।
ভবিষ্যতের কাজ: will finish / by tomorrow → will have finished।
'since morning' চলমান কাজ Present Perfect Continuous: has been + verb+ing।

items.q: When I reached the station, the train ___. (leave)
items.rule_bn: অতীতে দুটি কাজের আগেরটি Past Perfect: had left।

items.q: He ___ television when I saw him. (watch)
items.rule_bn: অতীতে চলমান কাজ Past Continuous: was + verb+ing।

items.q: Choose the correct form: 'He ___ to Dhaka last week.'
Choose the correct form: 'I ___ my homework yet.'
